Subject: Follow-up: payment setup options & vendor packet (PO vs Card / marketplace)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and where we need your input to finish procurement intake: 

1) Commercial path decision (please indicate one):
   - Purchase Order (PO) — standard net-30 invoicing, needs vendor setup packet + W-9 and banking details.
   - Corporate Card — immediate sign-up with card payment, smaller paperwork; billing via card on file.
   - Marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure) — if you prefer to transact through your cloud marketplace account.

2) Documents attached for Brightwave to complete if you select PO: vendor_onboarding_packet_v2.pdf (company info and ACH wiring template), banking_template.xlsx (banking fields), RW-W9-marcus_lin-signed.pdf (our W-9).

3) Next steps / timeline suggestion:
   - If PO: return completed vendor packet + banking template -> we issue invoice and start provisioning (typical 5–7 business days after completed packet).
   - If Card: confirm card holder and we’ll send the payment link, can activate within 24–48 hours.
   - If Marketplace: share the marketplace customer ID and preferred billing contact; partner setup takes 3–10 business days depending on account link.

Could you confirm which payment path you prefer and whether procurement needs a vendor portal onboarding link? If PO, please send the contact who will return the packet and their expected turnaround.

Thanks — happy to hop back on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks for the concise breakdown. A couple quick clarifications from procurement: 

- Brightwave prefers PO for any new enterprise relationships. That said, we try to minimize bank transfers; ACH is fine.
- We need to confirm if your W-9 on file has our legal name variance requirements — can you confirm the exact business name you use for invoicing (DBA / legal entity)?
- Marketplace: curious if Redwood already has a Brightwave listing on AWS Marketplace; if yes, any difference in price/contract?

I can take the vendor packet — I’m copying procurement@brightwave.com who will process the PO. Expect a turnaround of ~5 business days once we get the completed packet + W-9 + banking info.

Also, procurement has asked whether Redwood accepts invoices via a vendor portal or needs emailed PDFs.

Appreciate it — Samantha
